<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> occurs in this phase, it is highly recommended to utilise Devotion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the other Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is very important to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago as he jumps for the first time.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="ranged-bomb-tank-phase-4-scopulus" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Ranged Bomb Tank - Phase 4 Scopulus</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Your Base Tank is responsible for stacking all 3 Scopuli. At times though, a Scopulus might reaggro to one of the Bomb Tanks. In this case: </nowiki><em><nowiki>run!</nowiki></em><nowiki> Make sure to stay at the outside of the arena in order to avoid passing any Blue Bombs to your Base Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (optional, advanced) Use Natural Instinct </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of Phase 3</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#1 Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equip Mechanised Chinchompas </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mechchin">[[File:Mechanised chinchompa.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>|<nowiki>mechchin</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> once the first 2 Scopuli are stacked up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If available, prioritise using the Darkbow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbow">[[File:Dark bow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> special attack (stored in EoF </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofyellowu">[[File:Essence of Finality amulet (yellow).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1260022280046645349.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofyellowu</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofyellowu</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>) with Chins equipped</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drink from your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> after your first Darkbow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbow">[[File:Dark bow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of the phase (decide which of your Bomb Tanks)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The BT#1 utilises Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on the other BT for the second or third Blue Bomb in order to avoid taking too much damage. For slower phases, the other BT#2 should follow it up shortly after the first Devotion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> runs out.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Do </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> use Vulnerability Bombs </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vulnbomb">[[File:Vulnerability bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as Bomb Tank throughout Phase 4!</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Ranged Bomb Tank should always take the southern position during P4, due to lower attack range of Ranged dual wield compared to Magic. Positioning for Bomb Tanks in Phase 4 Scopulus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/rN3NFom.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="ranged-bomb-tank-phase-5-vitalis" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Ranged Bomb Tank - Phase 5 Vitalis</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Trio Hard Mode approaches Phase 5 similar to a fast Duo Normal Mode Vitalis Phase 3. All players stay in melee distance and must pray flick between melee </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMelee">[[File:Deflect Melee.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMelee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="DeflectMage">[[File:Deflect Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>|<nowiki>DeflectMage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. The Bomb Tanks commonly take the north-western corner and the eastern side in melee distance to Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: In the start of the phase, you can position 1 tile out of melee distance, but be ready to step into MD as the Vitalis orb explodes in order to avoid getting blocked or lost Line of Sight from spawned Vitali.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-ECB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ecb">[[File:Eldritch crossbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>|<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase, just like Phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> occurs in this phase, it is best to Devotion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> yourself, although it will mostly be on cooldown if you had a fast Phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is recommended to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the start of Phase 5.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="ranged-bomb-tank-phase-6-green-bomb" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Ranged Bomb Tank - Phase 6 Green Bomb</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>One Bomb Tank is assigned to placing a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into the phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-ECB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ecb">[[File:Eldritch crossbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>|<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase, just like Phases 3 and 5. This phase is significantly easier due to longer time until Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you receive a Green Bomb, simply drink a sip of your Powerburst of Vitality </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in order to easily survive it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> occurs in this phase, the Bomb Tank </nowiki><em><nowiki>who did not</nowiki></em><nowiki> receive the Green Bomb should Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the other one. You can also Resonance </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the first Blue Bomb after Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start safely, even with the caused defensive cooldown by a Green Bomb detonation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is very important to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago at the start of Phase 6.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="ranged-bomb-tank-phase-7-team-split" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Ranged Bomb Tank - Phase 7 Team Split</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>One Bomb Tank is assigned to placing a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into the phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Following a base guideline of abilities in this phase will significantly improve the overall outcome of Phase 7.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tag on tick with a Snap Shot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="snap">[[File:Snap Shot.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>snap</nowiki>|<nowiki>snap</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (quick hitting override required)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you tagged on tick, reprisal </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Reprisal">[[File:Reprisal.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>|<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> right away (optional: sip of your Powerburst of Vitality </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if ready)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Activate ECB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ecb">[[File:Eldritch crossbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>|<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> special attack on this phase's Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> - Do not target the dummy until you activate Reprisal </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Reprisal">[[File:Reprisal.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>|<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (optional, but recommended) Disruption Shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> during first the Team Split</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is very important to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago immediately after the first Team Split.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="ranged-bomb-tank-phase-8-the-end" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Ranged Bomb Tank - Phase 8 The End</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>In Phase 8 there exist different strategies (beginner &amp; advanced).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Beginner Strategy (Recommended)</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#1 tags all Blue Bombs and BT#2 Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> between third and last quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Beginner Strategy (Safe)</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each Bomb Tank tags 2-3 Red Bombs (avoid increased damage by one BT positioning at the outside, the other surging to the following quadrant </nowiki><em><nowiki>asap</nowiki></em><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#1 Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> between third and last quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#2 Barricade Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on Stand Up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Advanced Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: This strategy is only recommended to very experienced teams and highly discouraged to use for beginner/intermediate teams.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Natural Instinct </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of Phase 7</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 8</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drink from your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tag on Target Cycle with a Snap Shot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="snap">[[File:Snap Shot.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>snap</nowiki>|<nowiki>snap</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (quick hitting override required)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise ECB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ecb">[[File:Eldritch crossbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>|<nowiki>ecb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for first quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump everything and aim for killing it before the 3rd quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your Death's Swiftness </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathsswift">[[File:Death's Swiftness.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathsswift</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> happens to not be placed in the first or second quadrant of Vorago's arms, you should move to the second quadrant, even if you have to leave your ultimate for it. Otherwise you are very likely to die due to suffocation damage.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="ranged-bomb-tank-tips-rotations" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Ranged Bomb Tank - Tips &amp; Rotations </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-tips_1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Tips</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If performing the BT#2 role, transfigure </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Transfigure">[[File:Transfigure.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196523876354.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Transfigure</nowiki>|<nowiki>Transfigure</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for the 14k entry hit</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Stalling abilities is sometimes easier by mouse clicking a dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> placed far away from your drop location and far-casting an ability, instead of equipping Excalibur </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="excal">[[File:Augmented enhanced Excalibur.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>excal</nowiki>|<nowiki>excal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Disruption Shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> should be used during P2 BHD, end of P3, end of P4 / start of P5, during first TS P7, after tagging bombs P8</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Stay MD +1 in the start of P5 until Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Take Crackling </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="crack4">[[File:Crackling.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>crack4</nowiki>|<nowiki>crack4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> off for Reflects and end of P2 / P9</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Remove the armour piece with Mobile </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mob">[[File:Mobile.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mob</nowiki>|<nowiki>mob</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for Escape </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Surge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / Bladed Dive </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bd">[[File:Bladed Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bd</nowiki>|<nowiki>bd</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> generating adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Heal Other </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="HealOther">[[File:Heal Other icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>|<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> your Base Tank in P1 if they receive the Red Bomb and end of P2, P3, P4, P6 and P7</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Rather skip Natty </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> than using Natty too late</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="rotations_1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>For advanced ability damage rotations, refer to the official Rago Hub spreadsheet:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing <nowiki>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="strategy-summary_3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Strategy Summary</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/OR0DEsj.png</span></p>

<span id="magic-bomb-tank-introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Introduction </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/Yk0OqK4.png</span></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="introduction_3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Bomb Tanking at Trio Hard Mode can be performed in several setups. This section focuses on Magic, covering both Bomb Tank's responsibilities: Bomb Tank #1 and Bomb Tank #2 (the Climber). If you are Magic bomb tanking with a Hybrid on your team, read up on both this and the Hybrid section.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="required_2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Required</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Up to 4 </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Combat Dummies</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="recommended_2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Recommended</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Guthix Staff</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> stored in an Essence of Finality </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofpurple">[[File:Essence of Finality amulet (or)(purple).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofpurple</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofpurple</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Fury of the Small</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="furyofthesmall">[[File:Fury of the Small.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>furyofthesmall</nowiki>|<nowiki>furyofthesmall</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Seren Godbow</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Biting 17</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="biting4">[[File:Biting.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>biting4</nowiki>|<nowiki>biting4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Converting to a Ranged Bomb Tank</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Refer to the official Rago Hub spreadsheet for advanced ability damage rotations:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing <nowiki>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="strategy-summary_4" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Strategy Summary</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/IWZ6z4K.png</span></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phases-1-2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phases 1 &amp; 2 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 1</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is always recommended to have one Bomb Tank ranging in Trio Hard Mode, who will pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start of Phase 1 and deal damage to Vorago. The other Bomb Tank is responsible for Climbing and Top Luring, also referred to as Bomb Tank #2.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ As Magic Bomb Tank you will most likely be the one climbing in Phase 1.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Yet, if you happen to be the one DPSing, a simple Sunshine </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> standard rotation should be enough to bring Vorago's lifepoints low enough before the Climber jumps. Your Ultimate should be placed right in melee distance, west of Vorago's spawn location. This position should provide you 100% uptime of your Ultimate for most locations that Vorago is lured to. Slow down dealing damage as Vorago reaches 50,000 HP and off early enough to avoid a reset.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the Base Tank receives the second Red Bomb (random), you should cast Heal Other </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="HealOther">[[File:Heal Other icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>|<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to support the Base Tank's food management.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Phase 1 initial positioning</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/3iJfL4k.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 2</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank's responsibilities throughout Phase 2 are not any different to bomb tanking Normal Mode.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Usually the Bomb Tank #2 (the Climber) takes over Barricading </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and intercepting </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the first and third Red Bomb. The Bomb Tank #1 cade cepts the second one.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ You should have one person dedicated to shattering </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Shatter">[[File:Shatter.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Shatter</nowiki>|<nowiki>Shatter</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the end of Bring Him Down (preferably the Ranger).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ One Bomb Tank is assigned to placing a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> during Bring Him Down.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phases-3-8" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phases 3 - 8 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-3-ceilings" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 3 Ceilings</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (optional, advanced) Use Natural Instinct </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of Phase 2</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the center of Phase 3</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drink your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (BT #1) Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start of Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Detonate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> post-Reflect</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase. Executing a stable Metamorphosis </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="meta">[[File:Metamorphosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>meta</nowiki>|<nowiki>meta</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> ability damage rotation will increase the consistency of 0-linking Phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is very important to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago as he jumps for the first time.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-4-scopulus" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 4 Scopulus</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Your Base Tank is responsible for stacking all 3 Scopuli. At times though, a Scopulus might reaggro to one of the Bomb Tanks. In this case: run! Make sure to stay at the outside of the arena in order to avoid passing any Blue Bombs to your Base Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (BT #1) Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Greater Chain </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gchain">[[File:Greater Chain.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gchain</nowiki>|<nowiki>gchain</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is unlocked, follow it up with a Guthix Staff </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> special attack early in the phase (the Greater Chain buff applies the Guthix Staff affinity stacks and defence drain to all targets)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise AOE damaging abilities and 4taa</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Detonate as soon as all 3 Scopuli are stacked up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of the phase (decide which of your Bomb Tanks)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank #1 utilises Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on the other BT for the second or third Blue Bomb in order to avoid taking too much damage. For slower phases, the other BT#2 should follow it up shortly after the first Devotion runs out.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Do </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> use Vulnerability Bomb </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vulnbomb">[[File:Vulnerability bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as Bomb Tank throughout Phase 4!</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you 0-linked Phase 3, your Sunshine </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will be on cooldown for Scopulus. Simply dump Thresholds and Guthix Staff </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Positioning for Bomb Tanks in Phase 4 Scopulus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/rN3NFom.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-5-vitalis" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 5 Vitalis</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Trio Hard Mode approaches Phase 5 similar to a fast Duo Normal Mode Vitalis Phase 3. All players stay in melee distance and must pray flick for melee swipes and Blue Bombs. The Bomb Tanks commonly take the north-western corner and the eastern side in melee distance to Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: In the start of the phase, you can position 1 tile out of melee distance, but be ready to step into MD as the Vitalis orb explodes in order to avoid getting blocked or lost Line of Sight from spawned Vitali.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
