<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Detonate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump Thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase, just like Phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> occurs in this phase, it is best to Devotion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> yourself, although it will mostly be on cooldown if you had a fast Phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-6-green-bomb" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 6 Green Bomb</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>One Bomb Tank is assigned to placing a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into the phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (optional, advanced) Use Natural Instinct </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of Phase 5</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start of Phase 3</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drink your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Detonate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and make use of SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> pre-link</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (BT #1) Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start of Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase, just like Phases 3 and 5. This phase is significantly easier due to longer time until Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> start. If you are going for fast phases, you should skip your Apot </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in this phase and save it for Phase 8 instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you receive a Green Bomb, simply drink a sip of your Powerburst of Vitality </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in order to easily survive it.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> occurs in this phase, the Bomb Tank </nowiki><em><nowiki>who did not</nowiki></em><nowiki> receive the Green Bomb should Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the other one. You can also Resonance </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the first Blue Bomb after Reflect start safely, even with the caused defensive cooldown by a Green Bomb detonation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is very important to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago at the start of Phase 6.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-7-team-split" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 7 Team Split</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>One Bomb Tank is assigned to placing a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into the phase.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Following a base guideline of abilities in this phase will significantly improve the overall outcome of Phase 7.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (pre) </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and tag on tick with an Auto Deto GStaff </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodbarrage">[[File:Blood Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you tagged on tick, reprisal </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Reprisal">[[File:Reprisal.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>|<nowiki>Reprisal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> right away (optional: sip of your Powerburst of Vitality </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if ready)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (optional, but recommended) Disruption Shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> during first the Team Split</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If your team consists of a Hybrid Bomb Tank, it is very important to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago immediately after the first Team Split.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-phase-8-the-end" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Phase 8 The End</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>In Phase 8 there exist different strategies (beginner &amp; advanced).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Beginner Strategy (Recommended)</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#1 tags all Blue Bombs and BT#2 Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> between third and last quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Beginner Strategy (Safe)</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump thresholds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each Bomb Tank tags 2-3 Red Bombs (avoid increased damage by one BT positioning at the outside, the other surging to the following quadrant </nowiki><em><nowiki>asap</nowiki></em><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#1 Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> between third and last quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BT#2 Barricade Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on Stand Up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Advanced Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: This strategy is only recommended to very experienced teams and highly discouraged to use for beginner/intermediate teams.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Metamorphosis </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="meta">[[File:Metamorphosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>meta</nowiki>|<nowiki>meta</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 8 (drink from your Adrenaline Potion renew)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Detonate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and tag on Target Cycle with an Auto Deto GStaff </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodbarrage">[[File:Blood Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gstaff">[[File:Guthix staff.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>|<nowiki>gstaff</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Release a stalled Wild Magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="wm">[[File:Wild Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>wm</nowiki>|<nowiki>wm</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with a 2hit Asphyxiate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="asphyx">[[File:Asphyxiate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>|<nowiki>asphyx</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, followed up by an SGB spec (your Ingenuity of Humans </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will eventually be on cooldown from Phase 6)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can dump everything and aim for killing it before the 3rd quadrant.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="magic-bomb-tank-tips-rotations" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Magic Bomb Tank - Tips &amp; Rotations </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-tips_2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Tips</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Detonate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> should be pre-charged in most phases, as charging it during Reflects </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> would cause Detonate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deto">[[File:Detonate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deto</nowiki>|<nowiki>deto</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to be on cooldown for the following phase</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Use Barrage </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloodbarrage">[[File:Blood Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloodbarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as primary spell, Blitz might be nulled by Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (also P4 Scopulus benefits heavily from Barrage)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="rotations_2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>For advanced ability damage rotations, refer to the official Rago Hub spreadsheet:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing <nowiki>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="strategy-summary_5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Strategy Summary</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/IWZ6z4K.png</span></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="hybrid-melee-bomb-tank-introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Hybrid / Melee Bomb Tank - Introduction </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/g2qDH1x.png</span></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="introduction_4" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>A general Hybrid setup for Trio HM consists of Melee </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as primary and either Ranged </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or Magic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as secondary combat style. Magic is recommended due to the naturally increased hitchance on Scopuli. At the current unbalanced state of combat styles, there exists only one method of making Hybrid effective over a double Ranged Bomb Tank setup. Hybridding is only recommended if your goal is improved kill speed, as your team is a lot more likely to lose a kill.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is highly discouraged to take a BoB familiar (Mammoth scrolls with Soups </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sailfishsoup">[[File:Sailfish soup.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537336701933060106.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sailfishsoup</nowiki>|<nowiki>sailfishsoup</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>), due to the lost accuracy from a Nihil familiar already making Ranged a better choice over Hybrid. Therefore a Hybrid setup ends up having a very small amount of food (1 - 3 inventory slots). The selected aura should be Berserker </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="berserker">[[File:Berserker aura.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>|<nowiki>berserker</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In phases 1, 2, 4 (Scopulus) and 9 the Hybrid Bomb Tank uses the secondary combat style, Ranged or Magic.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Throughout phases 3 - 8 (excluding Scopulus P4) Melee is to be used. A primary portion of these phases will require you (the Hybridder) and the Base Tank to </nowiki><em><nowiki>step under</nowiki></em><nowiki> Vorago, with the BT#1 voking </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the boss.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Depending on the outcome of your Phase 10, you will either camp Melee for the start of P11 or switch to your secondary combat style immediately during phase transition.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ As Hybrid Bomb Tank you will be the one climbing in Phase 1.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Refer to the official Rago Hub spreadsheet for advanced ability damage rotations:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing <nowiki>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="strategy-summary_6" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Strategy Summary</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/SRvxKhJ.png</span></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phases-1-2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phases 1 &amp; 2 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 1</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Generally speaking, a Hybrid Bomb Tank takes over the BT#2 responsibilities. The other Bomb Tank #1 ultimates Phase 1 while the Hybridder climbs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Equip your secondary combat style for the Phase 1 to allow for tagging from the final platform of the Top Lure.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 2</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank's responsibilities throughout Phase 2 are not any different to bomb tanking Normal Mode.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Usually the Bomb Tank #2 (the Climber) takes over Barricading </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and intercepting </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the first and third Red Bomb. The Bomb Tank #1 cade cepts the second one.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ You should have one person dedicated to shattering </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Shatter">[[File:Shatter.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Shatter</nowiki>|<nowiki>Shatter</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> the end of Bring Him Down (preferably the Ranger).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Due to lacking inventory space as a Hybridder, it is recommended to have either the Base Tank or the Bomb Tank #1 take an additional Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>. One Bomb Tank is assigned to placing a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> during Bring Him Down (preferably the BT#1).</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phases-3-8" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phases 3 - 8 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-3-ceilings" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 3 Ceilings</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Natural Instinct </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of Phase 2</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 3</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• SGB </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> post-Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Your team should simply aim for 0-linking the phase. It is very important for the Bomb Tank #1 to voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago as he jumps away.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-4-scopulus" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 4 Scopulus</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Your Base Tank is responsible for stacking all 3 Scopuli. At times though, a Scopulus might reaggro to one of the Bomb Tanks. In this case: run! Make sure to stay at the outside of the arena in order to avoid passing any Blue Bombs to your Base Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sunshine">[[File:Sunshine.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>|<nowiki>sunshine</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise AOE damaging abilities and 4taa</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Detonate as soon as all 3 Scopuli are stacked up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise Limitless </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="limitless">[[File:Limitless.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>limitless</nowiki>|<nowiki>limitless</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for this Sunshine</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Place a Combat Dummy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dummy">[[File:Combat dummy MKII.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>|<nowiki>dummy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the end of the phase (preferably the BT#1).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank #1 utilises Devotion Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for the second or third Blue Bomb in order to avoid taking too much damage. For slower phases, the Hybridder should follow it up shortly after the first Devotion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> runs out.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Do </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> use Vulnerability Bombs </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="vulnbomb">[[File:Vulnerability bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>vulnbomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as Bomb Tank throughout Phase 4!</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Positioning for Bomb Tanks in Phase 4 Scopulus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/rN3NFom.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-5-vitalis" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 5 Vitalis</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Trio Hard Mode approaches Phase 5 similar to a fast Duo Normal Mode Vitalis Phase 3. All players stay in melee distance and must pray flick for melee swipes and Blue Bombs. The Hybridder commonly takes the north-western corner in melee distance to Vorago, with the BT#1 standing on the east side (opposite of L-Rock).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 5</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drink from your Adrenaline Potion </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="adrenrenewal">[[File:Adrenaline renewal potion (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>|<nowiki>adrenrenewal</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Fast teams should simply aim for 0-linking the phase, just like Phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> occurs in this phase, it is best to utilise your Seren Godbow special attack </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> shortly after.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to have your team's Bomb Tank #1 voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago throughout Phase 5 in order to allow for both the Base Tank and the Hybridder to step under from the opposite side.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-6-green-bomb" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 6 Green Bomb</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• ZGS spec </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zgs">[[File:Zaros godsword.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zgs</nowiki>|<nowiki>zgs</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as you drop into Phase 6</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Implement an SGB spec </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in your P6 ability rotation pre-Reflect </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the Hybridder or the Base Tank receive a Green Bomb, it will be bridged multiple times. A 0-link in this phase is basically guaranteed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to have your team's Bomb Tank #1 voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago throughout Phase 6 in order to allow for both the Base Tank and the Hybridder to step under.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-7-team-split" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 7 Team Split</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (pre) </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> shortly before Target Cycle (optimally 2 GCDs prior, to allow for a stalled basic released with another basic as soon as you Target Cycle)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilise Limitless </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="limitless">[[File:Limitless.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339233638023179.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>limitless</nowiki>|<nowiki>limitless</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for this Berserk</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to have your team's Bomb Tank #1 voke </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Vorago immediately after the first Team Split in order to allow for both the Base Tank and the Hybridder to step under.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-phase-8-the-end" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Phase 8 The End</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dump thresholds (pre-Barge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> with Mobile </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mob">[[File:Mobile.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mob</nowiki>|<nowiki>mob</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to allow for a double Greater Barge </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gbarge">[[File:Greater Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>|<nowiki>gbarge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> rotation)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• SGB spec </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sgb">[[File:Seren godbow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>|<nowiki>sgb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> in the first quadrant</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If a Stand Up is expected to happen, have the other Bomb Tank #1 tag all Red Bombs and then Barricade Intercept </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Cept">[[File:Intercept icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>|<nowiki>Cept</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on stand. The Hybridder should pre-Ultimate </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="zerk">[[File:Berserk.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>|<nowiki>zerk</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for Stand Up.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="hybrid-bomb-tank-tips-rotations" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Hybrid Bomb Tank - Tips &amp; Rotations </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Attack">[[File:Attack-icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>|<nowiki>Attack</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]]</span></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="general-tips_3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>General Tips</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Transfigure </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="Transfigure">[[File:Transfigure.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/553050196523876354.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>Transfigure</nowiki>|<nowiki>Transfigure</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for the 14k entry hit</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Dbow autos </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbow">[[File:Dark bow.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbow</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Disruption Shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> should be used during P2 BHD, end of P3, end of P4 / start of P5 and during first TS P7</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Step under for phases 5, 6 and 7</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Take Crackling </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="crack4">[[File:Crackling.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087662686249.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>crack4</nowiki>|<nowiki>crack4</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">4</span></span><nowiki> off for Reflects and end of P2 / P9</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Do not use the Mobile perk </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="mob">[[File:Mobile.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>mob</nowiki>|<nowiki>mob</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> on your armour directly and put it on your Excalibur </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="excal">[[File:Augmented enhanced Excalibur.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>excal</nowiki>|<nowiki>excal</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> instead</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Heal Other </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="HealOther">[[File:Heal Other icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>|<nowiki>HealOther</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> end of phases P3, P4, P6 and P7</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Rather skip Natty </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="nat">[[File:Natural Instinct.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>nat</nowiki>|<nowiki>nat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> than using Natty too late</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="rotations_3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Rotations</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Refer to the official Rago Hub spreadsheet for advanced ability damage rotations:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing <nowiki>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q7zscYcfJ9qXeIptQmXJiWUloalwDNtmxIOX7bqgkJg/edit?usp=sharing</nowiki>]</p>
